description: Swipes one finger from one point to another (touch events; use drag for the mouse). Scrolls touch lists and drives swipe gestures.

window.description: Window: target id from list_windows or part of its title. Optional when only one window is open.

x1.description: Start x, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

x2.description: End x, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y1.description: Start y, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y2.description: End y, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

name: swipe
title: Swipe
